say:4:1510523001:0.text: <style="highlight">Windfang Crag</style> is a narrow path along the edge of the <style="highlight">Taothos Rift</style>. Gorgonna used to sneak off here and disappear for hours.

say:5:1510523002:0.text: Her behavior raised suspicions, so I tracked her once.
say:5:1510523002:0.source_cn: 这种举动太过可疑，所以我跟踪过她一次。
say:5:1510523002:0.male: Her behavior raised suspicions, so I tracked her once.
say:5:1510523002:0.female: Her behavior raised suspicions, so I tracked her once.

say:7:1510523003:1.text: You used your divine gift to follow Gorgonna?
say:7:1510523003:1.source_cn: 你用神赐的能力跟踪露？

say:8:1510523004:0.text: We don't know where she came from or what her motives are. I was just taking basic precautions.
say:8:1510523004:0.source_cn: 她来历不明，这是基础防范。
